parent_objective: synthesize current-sim task-quality evidence and choose next paper-route branch
blocked_by: M2271 admits synthesis before any further repair or training

public_gates: M2272 must answer the standard synthesis questions
M2272 must classify evidence under engineering performance, history mechanism, task quality, high-fidelity readiness, and workflow complexity axes
M2272 must select continue pivot stop or promote_to_next_branch
M2272 must not run reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: synthesizes M2236-M2271 task-quality evidence into a next-branch decision
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: branch synthesis only; no rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if synthesis cannot choose a decision
stop if synthesis recommends another scalar reward tweak without new evidence axis
stop if synthesis claims comparison readiness from below-floor public diagnostic support
fallback_plan: pivot to scenario/task-quality redesign if readiness remains blocked
continue only on a new evidence axis with pre-registered acceptance
stop for user review if evidence is contradictory

admission_evidence: M2271 freezes synthesis scope and questions
M2270 stops immediate containment reward local search
governing paper-route plans require task quality before ranking/self-ID claims
allowed_updates: M2272 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by synthesis
next_stage_criteria: synthesis decision is one of continue pivot stop promote_to_next_branch
next route is selected without new experiment execution

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2272 is process synthesis and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2272; no wrong-history reset-hidden or zero-history intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If task quality blocks comparison, pivot to task/scenario quality instead of weakening self-ID criteria.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: integrates multiple prior branches rather than adding another local repair
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can pivot the paper route toward scenario/task-quality redesign or comparison redesign
must_synthesize_if: the next proposed task is another scalar reward tweak

hypothesis: Synthesizing M2236-M2271 will identify the next paper-route branch more reliably than continuing current-sim local repair.
success_criteria: the synthesis answers all required questions
the synthesis decision is continue pivot stop or promote_to_next_branch
the synthesis blocks ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims unless explicitly supported
a follow-up non-ranking route is selected
failure_criteria: M2272 omits a required synthesis question
M2272 recommends another scalar reward tweak without a new evidence axis
M2272 starts new training reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2272 ranks profiles or selects a winner
M2272 makes finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 self-ID claims

commands.name: synthesize
commands.command: manual synthesis artifact over M2236-M2271 current-sim task-quality evidence

decision_rule: M2272 passes if it writes the required synthesis and selects a non-ranking follow-up route.
